featured_projects.title: HerMediSafe
featured_projects.description: HerMediSafe is an AI-powered healthcare platform designed to improve medication safety for pregnant and breastfeeding women. It analyzes uploaded prescriptions to detect duplicate medicines and potential drug interactions, while providing dosage reminders and affordable generic medicine alternatives. The platform also offers a multilingual AI assistant and downloadable medical reports to support safer, more informed discussions with healthcare professionals.
